# Teton Peaks AI

> Done-for-you AI automation for small businesses in Idaho Falls and the Snake River Valley of Eastern Idaho. Teton Peaks AI is a dba of Prooformance LLC, based in Idaho Falls, Idaho.

- Phone: 208-710-6351 (call or text)
- Service area: Idaho Falls, Ammon, Rexburg, Rigby, Pocatello, Blackfoot, Shelley, St. Anthony, Driggs
- Book a free AI process consultation: https://calendly.com/tetonpeaksai/free-ai-process-consultation

## Services and prices
- Missed-Call Rescue Pilot: $297 one-time, 30 days. Full refund if it does not win back at least one missed-call lead in 30 days.
- Missed-Call Rescue: $147/month plus $497 setup. Missed-call text back, alerts, monthly report.
- Lead Engine: $297/month plus $997 setup. Adds fast replies to web and Facebook leads, a booking link, and review requests.
- AI Front Desk: $497/month plus $2,497 setup. Adds an AI receptionist that answers, asks the right questions, and books 24/7.
- AI Process Audit: $1,500. A written plan, credited toward a build.
- Custom Build: from $3,000 setup plus $500/month.
